title: [bug] runDemo does not reuse an existing demo campaign on a later run
description: origin/main is red: packages/cli/test/play.test.ts 'reuses an existing demo campaign on a later run' fails. A second runDemo() call on the same db prints the created-campaign branch ("Demo campaign 'campaign-N' — ...") instead of the existing-campaign branch ("Demo campaign: <title> ..."), meaning getCampaign(db) returns undefined even though run 1 created the campaign. Reproduces in isolation (npx vitest run packages/cli/test/play.test.ts => 1 failed / 11 passed) and in the full suite (1 failed / 224 passed / 5 skipped). Likely fallout from the recent JSON-column codec persistence migration. Not part of the loreweaver-d4r P2 review-findings batch; filed separately so main can be made green.
acceptance_criteria: play.test.ts demo-campaign-reuse test passes; a second runDemo on the same db resolves and resumes the existing campaign; full suite green.
close_reason: Not a code regression. The play.test.ts demo-campaign-reuse failure reproduced only when running 'vitest' against a stale/missing @loreweaver/core dist build (the worktree had no prior tsc build). With a fresh build the test passes; full 'npm test' is green (238 passed / 1 skipped). This false failure is exactly the class loreweaver-vzv addresses: the root 'pretest' build added there (tsc --build before vitest) prevents stale-build test runs.
